thesis: CROX is a high-quality, cheap, cash-generative name in a clean uptrend after a post-earnings re-rating, and it has held its gap since 10-29 while the Nasdaq sold off. Earnings momentum is accelerating (net income +48.65% YoY) at a forward P/E under 10, with positive free cash flow and low dilution risk. The setup is a pullback entry, not a chase. A dip into 154.5-158.5 with a stop under the 149.5 base low gives a reward/risk of 2.9 toward the measured-move target. This is a moderate long at best. The stock is extended, close to the consensus target, and the regime is risk-off with rising yields, so entry discipline matters more than conviction.
